title: College Entrance Exam
synopsis: The college entrance exam is where the future is decided for many young Chinese. In this personal story a Chinese girl recounts her time as a school girl preparing for the exam.

fullText.simplified:
那年，我高考（一）
    今天是6月7日，又是一年一度的高考。今天，报纸、电视、网站谈的都是同一个话题—高考。是的，每年的这一天，都是所有人最关心的日子。因为，这一天，你，或者你的亲人，或者你的孩子，总有那么一个人，正坐在考场上，牵动着所有人的心。毕竟，“一考定终身”呢。
    十年前的今天，我也是坐在考场上的其中一人。十年过去了，很多事都已淡忘，唯独高考的那段日子，依然清晰地留在我的记忆里。
    记得从进入高三开始，整个世界都变了。学校的墙上，开始贴上了高考的倒计时，班里的墙上，换上了“提高一分，干掉千人”这样的充满杀气的标语。没有了双休日，没有了节假日，没有了体育课、音乐课，所有的时间都给了高考必考的语文、数学、英语和综合理科。
    我们是住宿学校，所有的生活都在学校里。早上5点半起床，为了保证有健康的身体迎接高考，首先我们要集体跑步。还记得，那时候要边跑步，边喊口号—“要成功，先发疯”，每天都喊，感觉一大早的，整个人都被洗脑了。
fullText.traditional:
那年，我高考（一）
    今天是6月7日，又是一年一度的高考。今天，報紙、電視、網站談的都是同一個話題—高考。是的，每年的這一天，都是所有人最關心的日子。因為，這一天，你，或者你的親人，或者你的孩子，總有那麼一個人，正坐在考場上，牽動著所有人的心。畢竟，“一考定終身”呢。
    十年前的今天，我也是坐在考場上的其中一人。十年過去了，很多事都已淡忘，唯獨高考的那段日子，依然清晰地留在我的記憶裡。
    記得從進入高三開始，整個世界都變了。學校的牆上，開始貼上了高考的倒計時，班裡的牆上，換上了“提高一分，幹掉千人”這樣的充滿殺氣的標語。沒有了雙休日，沒有了節假日，沒有了體育課、音樂課，所有的時間都給了高考必考的語文、數學、英語和綜合理科。
    我們是住宿學校，所有的生活都在學校裡。早上5點半起床，為了保證有健康的身體迎接高考，首先我們要集體跑步。還記得，那時候要邊跑步，邊喊口號—“要成功，先發瘋”，每天都喊，感覺一大早的，整個人都被洗腦了。

raw.synopsis: The college entrance exam is where the future is decided for many young Chinese. In this personal story a Chinese girl recounts her time as a school girl preparing for the exam.
sentence_translations: That year, I did my college entrance exam (Part I)
Today, June 7th, is once again the day of the yearly entrance exam.
Today, newspapers, TV and internet sites all discuss the one same subject - the college entrance exam.
That's right, this day every year is the one day that everyone cares the most about.
Because on this day you, your relative or your child, there is always someone, sits in the exam room affecting everyone's hearts.
After all, "one exam decides your entire life".
Ten years ago today, I too was among the people sitting in the exam room
Ten years have passed and I have forgotten a lot of things, but this particular day of the entrance exam still lies clearly in my memory.
I remember that from the start of the third year of high school, the entire world changed.
Countdowns to the entrance exam were posted on the walls of the school.
The classroom wall turned into a written slogan full of murderous spirit saying "Improve one point, eliminate one thousand people".
No more weekends, no more holidays, no more sports class, no more music class.
All the time was spent on subjects necessary for the entrance exam: Chinese, Math, English and Science.
We went to a boarding school, so our entire livelihood was spent at school.
We got up at 5:30 in the morning. In order to ensure that our bodies were healthy to greet the entrance exam, we started off by running in groups.
I still remember, at the time we had to run while simultaneously shouting the slogan "In order to succeed, first go mad".
We shouted it every day, and it felt like everyone in the early morning had been brainwashed.
